upstream.mappingMethod: device-reported display name rules; image bytes are hosted in the upstream Cloudflare R2 bucket, outside the repository
upstream.license: AGPL-3.0 applies to the upstream program; the upstream artwork README identifies model renders as third-party assets with separate, often unconfirmed redistribution terms
upstream.note: Only assets with explicit redistribution approval are emitted into the local product-image map. Upstream-listed renders are not automatically redistributable.
